rows.note: Use 照 as the everyday all-purpose choice when following instructions, rules, or someone's stated directions.

example.english: According to the teacher, we have to be back at school by eight tomorrow morning.
example.traditional: 照老師講，聽日朝早八點前要返到學校。
example.jyutping: ziu3 lou5 si1 gong2 ting1 jat6 ziu1 zou2 baat3 dim2 cin4 jiu3 faan2 dou3 hok6 haau6

rows.note: Use 根據 when attributing information or authority to a source, report, or stated basis rather than describing dependence on a changing condition.

example.english: According to the Observatory's report, it will rain heavily tonight.
example.traditional: 根據天文台嘅報告，今晚會落大雨。
example.jyutping: gan1 geoi3 tin1 man4 toi4 ge3 bou3 gou3 gam1 maan5 wui2 lok6 daai6 jyu5

rows.note: Use 睇 A when the result depends on a person's preference, circumstances, or some other variable.

example.english: Whether we go to the beach depends on the weather; according to the Observatory, it will rain tomorrow.
example.traditional: 我哋去唔去沙灘，要睇天氣；天文台預測聽日會落雨。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 m4 heoi3 saa1 taan1 jiu3 tai2 tin1 hei3 tin1 man4 toi4 jyu6 caak1 ting1 jat6 wui5 lok6 jyu5
